Timeline::epoch_micros¶

Back to Timeline API Reference

Signature¶

Series Timeline::epoch_micros() const

Project Instants Onto Microsecond Ticks¶

epoch_micros() returns a shape-preserving Int64 Series whose values count whole microseconds from 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z. Conversion uses floor division. Consequently every instant in [-1000ns, -1ns] belongs to microsecond -1; it is not truncated into microsecond 0.

const auto times = pluss::timeline::from_epoch(
    {{-1LL, 0LL}, {1'999'999'999LL, pluss::Timeline::kNaT}});
std::cout << pluss::series::print(times.epoch_micros()) << '\n';

Output¶

Series(shape=[2,2], strides=[2,1], dtype=int64, platform=cpu, numel=4, contiguous=true)
data=
⎡       -1                    0 ⎤
⎣  1999999 -9223372036854775808 ⎦

Sub-microsecond precision is discarded, so this projection is reversible only when every valid nanosecond tick is divisible by 1,000. NaT remains Timeline::kNaT; timezone metadata is not carried by the returned Series.
